steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 'Within Her Eyes' was choreographed by James Cousins and premiered in 2012

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The work is a duet for one male and one female dancer exploring love, loss and memory

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The choreographic intention is to show the emotional weight of a relationship — the woman is never placed on the floor, always supported

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The stimulus was the concept of carrying emotional and physical weight within a relationship

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: What is the choreographic intention of 'Within Her Eyes'? | Q: Why are lifts the defining movement feature of this work? | Q: How does the costume contribute to the meaning of the work?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: To explore the emotional weight of a relationship — the woman is never placed on the floor, always supported, representing love, dependence and the burden of emotional connection. | Lifts physically embody the choreographic intention — the male supports the female throughout, making the idea of carrying emotional weight visible and tangible to the audience. | Everyday clothing makes the dancers relatable and the relationship believable — it suggests this could be any couple, not stylised theatrical characters.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always mention that the female is never placed on the floor — this is the most distinctive feature of the work Link every movement feature to the choreographic intention of emotional weight and support Discuss lifts specifically — describe how they work, not just that they exist Include design elements: costume, lighting and aural setting all contribute to the intimate atmosphere When comparing, note that this work is the only duet among the set works — intimacy is its defining quality
